subject: Conductor diff_comments: observed values of state, location and file_level
method: REA inspect_sqlite_database on a column-only snapshot (state, location, file_level; no comment bodies or paths) taken from ~/Library/Application Support/com.conductor.app/conductor.db on Sven's Mac. The full database plus WAL (7,077,396,480 bytes) exceeds REA's 256 MiB offline snapshot budget, so REA refused it with resource_constraint and its remediation asks for a smaller snapshot.
not_observed: an old-side location value (OpenConductor uses base, inferred)
rea_gaps: inspect_sqlite_database has no column/row projection on the source file, so a large app database needs an out-of-band subset copy before REA can read it; that copy is not REA-attested against the source.
